verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no official MCP server. The llms.txt index and markdown doc pages are AI-readable documentation, an adjacent feature that does not let an agent connect to Kushki via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
